exitCodes.0: No measured FAIL; manual/evidence review may still remain pending. Never overall artistic approval.
exitCodes.1: At least one measured technical FAIL.
exitCodes.2: Missing input/tool or runtime error. No fabricated pass report.

sceneDetectionPolicy: Raw FFmpeg scene scores; all thresholds report every missed boundary, nearest-frame lag and extra detection. Detection is evidence-review separate from EDL/actual-shot-presence. S37→S38 exempt as continuous; S20→S21 postwhite at687 is valid+1.

sourceFreezeProofSchema.note: Optional --source-freeze-proof JSON; paths resolved relative to manifest. All actual files/hashes verified; each group must cover exact prescribed frames with one identicalSHA256. Empty/unverifiable manifests cannot pass.

holdPolicy: Exact decoded identity passes; nonidentical decoded frames are codec-compatible or inconclusive REVIEW. Max outliers alone never imply motion. Verified source hashes establish source hold independently; obvious actual content movement would require visual evidence.

actualPacketIdentity.expected: Same complete MP3 packetSHA256 sequence; container metadata/PTS may differ

actualAudioAlignment.lagSign: positive means final audio delayed relative to source
actualAudioAlignment.scope: mono11025Hz decoded waveforms; maximum search lag±1s; allowed alignment±1frame, similarity>=.9999

actualAVWindowMedian.scope: Actual mono decoded audio RMS in30fps bins versus mean absolute grayscale frame difference at480x270. Nonoverlapping4s windows; final>=2s accepted; lag search±15frames. Positive lag means picture changes follow audio. This correlation of unlike signals is a diagnostic, not proof of creative sync. Raw arrays included; no threshold adjustment or low-score exclusion.
